503	    let distrib = temp.path().join("target/distrib");
504	    fs::create_dir_all(&distrib).expect("distrib dir");
505	    // Real archives: verify-manifest fails closed on unreadable or
506	    // "./"-prefixed archives, so placeholder bytes are not valid fixtures.
507	    for stem in [
508	        "deadreckon-aarch64-apple-darwin",
509	        "deadreckon-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu",
510	    ] {
511	        let payload = temp.path().join("payload").join(stem);
512	        fs::create_dir_all(&payload).expect("payload");
513	        fs::write(payload.join("deadreckon"), stem).expect("binary");
514	        let output = Command::new("tar")
515	            .args([
516	                "-cJf",
517	                distrib
518	                    .join(format!("{stem}.tar.xz"))
519	                    .to_str()
520	                    .expect("utf8 path"),
521	                "-C",
522	                temp.path().join("payload").to_str().expect("utf8 path"),
523	                stem,
524	            ])
525	            .output()
526	            .expect("tar");
527	        assert!(
528	            output.status.success(),
529	            "{}",
530	            String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr)
531	        );
532	    }
533	    fs::create_dir_all(distrib.join("trust")).expect("trust dir");
534	    fs::write(
535	        distrib.join("trust/macos-aarch64-apple-darwin.json"),
536	        r#"{"target":"aarch64-apple-darwin","signed":true,"notarized":true}"#,
537	    )
538	    .expect("mac trust");
539	
540	    assert_release_trust_success([
541	        "sbom",
542	        "--dir",
543	        distrib.to_str().expect("utf8 path"),
544	        "--out",
545	        distrib
546	            .join("release.spdx.json")
547	            .to_str()
548	            .expect("utf8 path"),
549	    ]);
550	    assert_release_trust_success([
551	        "checksums",
552	        "--dir",
553	        distrib.to_str().expect("utf8 path"),
554	        "--out",
555	        distrib.join("SHA256SUMS").to_str().expect("utf8 path"),
556	    ]);
557	    assert_release_trust_success([
558	        "manifest",
559	        "--dir",
560	        distrib.to_str().expect("utf8 path"),
561	        "--ref",
562	        "refs/tags/v1.2.3-rc.1",
563	        "--repo",
564	        "gregce/deadreckon",
565	        "--commit",
566	        "abc123",
567	        "--out",
568	        distrib
569	            .join("release-manifest.json")
570	            .to_str()
571	            .expect("utf8 path"),
572	    ]);
573	    assert_release_trust_success([
574	        "verify-manifest",
575	        "--dir",
576	        distrib.to_str().expect("utf8 path"),
577	        "--manifest",
578	        distrib
579	            .join("release-manifest.json")
580	            .to_str()
581	            .expect("utf8 path"),
582	        "--checksums",
583	        distrib.join("SHA256SUMS").to_str().expect("utf8 path"),
584	    ]);
585	
586	    let manifest = read_json(&distrib.join("release-manifest.json"));
587	    assert_eq!(
588	        Some(1),
589	        manifest.get("schema_version").and_then(JsonValue::as_u64)
590	    );
591	    assert_eq!(Some("rc"), manifest.get("lane").and_then(JsonValue::as_str));
592	    let artifacts = manifest
593	        .get("artifacts")
594	        .and_then(JsonValue::as_array)
595	        .expect("artifacts array");
596	    assert!(
597	        artifacts
598	            .iter()
599	            .any(|artifact| artifact.get("name").and_then(JsonValue::as_str)
600	                == Some("deadreckon-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.xz")
601	                && artifact.get("signed").and_then(JsonValue::as_bool) == Some(true)
602	                && artifact.get("notarized").and_then(JsonValue::as_bool) == Some(true)),
603	        "{manifest:#?}"
604	    );
605	    assert!(
606	        artifacts
607	            .iter()
608	            .any(|artifact| artifact.get("name").and_then(JsonValue::as_str) == Some("SHA256SUMS")),
609	        "{manifest:#?}"
610	    );
611	    assert!(
612	        artifacts
613	            .iter()
614	            .any(|artifact| artifact.get("name").and_then(JsonValue::as_str)
615	                == Some("release.spdx.json")),
616	        "{manifest:#?}"
617	    );

874	#[test]
875	fn checksums_record_flat_basenames_and_collapse_nested_duplicates() {
876	    let temp = tempfile::TempDir::new().expect("tempdir");
877	    let distrib = temp.path().join("target/distrib");
878	    fs::create_dir_all(distrib.join("target/distrib")).expect("nested dir");
879	    fs::write(distrib.join("deadreckon-installer.sh"), b"#!/bin/sh\n").expect("installer");
880	    // Build intermediates (extracted per-target dirs with loose binaries)
881	    // are not published assets and must never appear in SHA256SUMS — their
882	    // basenames collide across targets with different content.
883	    let loose = distrib.join("deadreckon-aarch64-apple-darwin");
884	    fs::create_dir_all(&loose).expect("loose dir");
885	    fs::write(loose.join("deadreckon"), b"mac binary").expect("loose binary");
886	    // The CI global-artifact layout nests some files twice with identical
887	    // content; SHA256SUMS must record one flat basename per asset so users
888	    // can run `shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS` next to downloaded files.
889	    fs::write(
890	        distrib.join("target/distrib/deadreckon-installer.sh"),
891	        b"#!/bin/sh\n",
892	    )
893	    .expect("nested duplicate");
894	    let sums = distrib.join("SHA256SUMS");
895	
896	    assert_release_trust_success([
897	        "checksums",
898	        "--dir",
899	        distrib.to_str().expect("utf8 path"),
900	        "--out",
901	        sums.to_str().expect("utf8 path"),
902	    ]);
903	
904	    let raw = fs::read_to_string(&sums).expect("sums");
905	    assert_eq!(raw.lines().count(), 1, "{raw}");
906	    let line = raw.lines().next().expect("entry");
907	    assert!(
908	        line.ends_with("  deadreckon-installer.sh"),
909	        "entry must be a flat basename: {line}"
910	    );
911	    assert!(
912	        !line.contains('/'),
913	        "no path segments in SHA256SUMS: {line}"
914	    );
915	}

Reviewed both touched files in full. The change is purely additive: three new tests in `release_plan.rs` and one explicit `checksum = "sha256"` line in `dist-workspace.toml`.

Analysis:
- **`release_plan.rs`**: The three new test functions invoke `release_trust(...)` with only static string literals (`"refs/tags/v0.1.0"`, `"gregce/deadreckon"`, etc.), read fixture files under `tempfile::TempDir`, and read repo-relative files (`release/install.sh`, `docs/V1-CANDIDATES.md`, `Cargo.toml`) via `workspace_root()` (which resolves via `env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")`, a build-time constant). No attacker-influenced data reaches any sink. `release_trust` itself spawns `node` with a fixed script path and no shell interpretation — no command-injection path. `workspace_version_string()` parses the in-tree `Cargo.toml` and `.expect`s on missing fields, which is fine in a test. These are assertion tests of security policy (changelog gate, npm version match, installer SHA256SUMS verification), not implementations of it — they cannot themselves introduce vulnerabilities into shipping code.
- **`dist-workspace.toml`**: Adds `checksum = "sha256"`. This explicitly pins the algorithm cargo-dist uses for `*.sha256` and `SHA256SUMS`. It is a security hardening (removes implicit-default risk) with no negative direction — sha256 remains an accepted collision-resistant algorithm in this domain. It does not weaken any control, broaden any allowlist, or introduce any new sink.

No entry points, sinks, parsers, allowlists, IaC defaults, or trust boundaries are touched in a way that could regress security. The `checksum = "sha256"` pin is the intended hardening; the rest is test coverage.
